speaker: Arlequino
topic: Barlas ancestral war against northern empire

canon.imperial_strategy: The empire split its army and defended cities, assuming the steppe army lacked siege technology and magic.
canon.steppe_counter: The steppe commander ordered every warrior to carry two small bags of earth and dump them at one point against a city wall, creating an earthen ramp. He declared he would make their horses climb the enemy walls.
canon.first_city: The army lost many thousands but captured the first city via the earthen ramp.
canon.siege_technology: Engineers from the captured city then produced siege engines, enabling the steppe forces to take the rest of the empire's cities.
canon.major_battle: One major field battle occurred: approximately 300000 imperial troops against approximately 100000 steppe troops.
canon.decisive_break: After the imperial commander was killed, the emperor left the battlefield and the imperial army broke and fled.

note: Treat as Arlequino's inherited family/tribal historical account within the simulation, not independently verified objective history unless corroborated elsewhere.
